summary: Mundus MAPP is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in public policy. You spend the first year at Central European University in Vienna or the International Institute of Social Studies in The Hague, and the second at IBEI in Barcelona or the University of York. Scholarship holders pay no tuition and receive €1,400 a month for 24 months. The scholarship deadline is 1 December 2026.
meta_title: Mundus MAPP 2027: Erasmus Mundus public policy scholarship
meta_description: Mundus MAPP pays no tuition plus €1,400 a month for a two-year public policy master's in Vienna, The Hague, Barcelona or York. Deadline 1 December 2026.
covers: A full tuition waiver. Self-funded students pay €13,000 a year.
€1,400 a month for 24 months, up to €33,600, meant for travel, visa, settling in and living costs.
Health insurance bought by the consortium.
A degree from both universities on your track: CEU and IBEI, CEU and York, ISS and IBEI, or ISS and York.
eligibility: A bachelor's degree of at least three years, with at least an upper second (2:1) where classes apply and a GPA of at least 3.17 out of 4.0 or equivalent.
Bachelor's degrees in the natural sciences or engineering are not eligible; social science degrees are preferred.
Work experience is not required, but relevant experience is preferred. Applicants who already hold a master's come second for scholarships.
how_to_apply: Choose one of the four tracks and complete that track's online form, ticking that you want to be considered for a scholarship. There is no separate scholarship application.
Upload a full CV, a statement of purpose of no more than 500 words, English translations of your transcript and diploma, and proof of English.
Two recommendation letters must arrive within 7 days of your submission.
Submit by 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET. Decisions, scholarships included, are announced on 14 April 2027.
watch_out: Citizens of Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa and the other countries on Mundus MAPP's list with an English-taught degree need no English certificate. Others need IELTS Academic 7.0, TOEFL iBT 95, Duolingo 130, PTE 76 or a Cambridge C1 or C2.
There are no extra travel payments: flights and visas come out of the monthly allowance, and the study visit and winter school cost €600 to €1,000 each on top.
Scholarships are few. One Institutional Scholarship per track gives a 50% tuition waiver with no stipend.
documents: The online form for your chosen track
A statement of purpose of up to 500 words
English translations of your bachelor's transcript and diploma, or proof that you will finish by 15 August 2027
Proof of English, or your English-taught degree from a listed country
Two recommendation letters, within 7 days of applying

faq.q: When is the Mundus MAPP scholarship deadline?
faq.a: 1 December 2026 at 23:59 Central European Time, for the cohort that starts in 2027.

faq.q: Can engineers apply to Mundus MAPP?
faq.a: No. The programme says bachelor's degrees in the natural sciences or engineering are not eligible.
Not if their degree was taught in English: Ghana is on the programme's list of countries whose English-taught degrees count as proof.
